anomalies.observed: The two VSS pins of the NAVC MCU (pins 18 and 63) sit on their own auto-named net 'Net-(NAVC1-VSS-Pad18)' and are not on GND. The four VDD pins (19, 32, 48, 64) and VSSA (12) each appear only as 'unconnected-' single-pin nets. By contrast, the FCC1 VSS pins are all on GND.
anomalies.expected: All VSS/VSSA pins of the NAVC1 MCU should be on GND and all VDD/VDDA pins on the 3V3 rail, so the MCU has a ground return and supply.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The NAVC MCU would have no ground reference and no supply pins connected, so it cannot power up or run, and the NAVC side of the flight computer link and sensor bus would be dead.

anomalies.observed: UART3 TX and RX are tied to FCC1 pins 48 and 73, which are the internal regulator VCAP outputs (power_out). Neither VCAP pin has a decoupling capacitor on its net.
anomalies.expected: UART3 signals should be on GPIO/alternate-function pins. VCAP pins should only connect to the regulator decoupling capacitor (about 2.2 uF to ground), not to signal lines.
anomalies.impact: The UART3 link would not function, and the regulator VCAP node would be loaded or shorted by the connector lines. This can prevent the MCU's internal core regulator from stabilising.

anomalies.observed: The FCC1 NRST pin (pin 14) is on its own 'unconnected-(FCC1-NRST-Pad14)' net. The reset net NRST_FCC (reset switch SW1, reset cap C31 and SWD1 pin 10) does not reach the MCU.
anomalies.expected: The MCU NRST pin should be tied to the NRST_FCC net so the reset switch, reset capacitor and debug header can reset the processor.
anomalies.impact: The FCC MCU cannot be reset by the switch or the debug header, which hampers recovery and programming. The same pattern appears on NAVC1 pin 7, so both processors lack a proper reset path.

parsed.summary: The netlist shows several MCU supply, ground and signal pins left unconnected or tied to the wrong nets: NAVC1 VSS/VDD, UART3 on the FCC1 VCAP pins, and FCC1 NRST. The strongest evidence is the NAVC1 ground and supply pins being isolated from GND and 3V3.
